headline.eyebrow: For those who want to make conscious choices
headline.tagline: A novel about the decisions we make — and the world our creations inherit.
headline.logline: An Iranian immigrant programmer is invited to the ACE game, where conscious decisions become social therapy—and a bloodless revolution could heal humanity and its creations.
